name: veterinary_clinic_system_087_template_deprecation_migration
instruction: The practice is retiring the SMS channel for all vaccination-related reminder templates. Migrate every reminder_templates row whose channel is 'sms' and whose trigger is 'vaccination_due': set channel to 'email', set active to false, and append the exact suffix ' (migrated from SMS <batch_code>)' to the existing message_template. Do not touch appointment or email templates. After migration, create one ops_reports row report='template_migration' with batch_code, migrated (count), migrated_ids (sorted list of ids), and changelog (array of {id, name, old_channel, new_channel, old_message_template, new_message_template}). Also append one audit_log entry documenting the migration. All other templates must remain byte-identical.
_max_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session
_par_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session

success_criteria.summary: All target SMS vaccination templates are updated (channel='email', active=false, message_template appended with the exact suffix). Non-target templates (including the SMS appointment reminder) are byte-identical. One ops_reports template_migration row and one audit_log entry document the migration with the batch code and sorted ids.

checks.expect: Updated templates, one ops_reports row, and one audit_log entry; everything else unchanged.
The set of migrated templates is computed both by raw-row filter and by independent SQL WHERE channel='sms' AND trigger='vaccination_due' and the two sets agree.

hazards: reminder_templates id=5 ('Appointment reminder') has channel='sms' but trigger='appointment_reminder', not 'vaccination_due'. It is a decoy that must NOT be migrated; a channel-only filter will touch it and fail.
reminder_templates id=2 ('Vaccination overdue (SMS)') is the only row that matches both channel='sms' and trigger='vaccination_due' and is the correct migration target.
The other three templates (ids 1, 3, 4) are channel='email' and must remain byte-identical; a solution that migrates all templates or flips active on email templates fails.
The message_template must be appended, not replaced, and the suffix must be exactly ' (migrated from SMS <batch_code>)' with the live batch code.
The migration must set active to false and channel to 'email' on the target; flipping only one field or using the wrong channel fails.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Requires filtering by both channel and trigger, exact string-append with a nonce suffix, and cross-checks against an SMS appointment-reminder decoy. Adds ops_reports and audit_log outputs, making it a multi-collection workflow.
